name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or new capability
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem or workflow

What are you trying to accomplish, and where does the current workflow fall short?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the result you would like to see. Focus on the user-facing behavior before implementation details.

## Where it belongs

- [ ] Projects
- [ ] Backups / recovery
- [ ] PM2 / process monitoring
- [ ] Docker / service health
- [ ] File Tools / Text Sanitizer
- [ ] Desktop application
- [ ] Browser dashboard
- [ ] LAN Remote Agent
- [ ] Documentation / Help
- [ ] Other

## Safety and compatibility considerations

Could this affect backups, restores, filesystem writes, process controls, authentication, remote access, or existing project configurations?

## Alternatives considered

What workarounds or other approaches have you tried?

## Additional context

Mockups, examples, or related projects/issues are welcome.
